verdict.rationale: Ramp's API/CLI/MCP stack supports bulk-style reads and exports — pulling full spend exports for SQL-style analysis, listing/searching transactions in bulk, syncing transaction/reimbursement data to multiple entities in one step, and even a documented batch ingestion endpoint for AI usage events — plus a 174-path OpenAPI surface an agent could loop over. However, the evidence shows mostly single-item write operations (approve one transaction/bill/reimbursement, lock one card) rather than a dedicated bulk-write/batch-update endpoint or CLI verb for acting on many items at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk write/batch-approve or batch-update API, and independent confirmation of large-scale bulk operations succeeding in practice.
